notes.title: RPS Runner update #2
notes.content:
Changelog:

-Added key binding options.
-Fixed some graphics to better fit the art-style of the game.
-Balanced the game a bit, the game was too easy past score 1000 as the speed was same, bumping that up a little. Now objects should spawn a bit close to each other when faster speeds.

notes.title: RPS Runner update #1
notes.content:
changelog:

-Change aspect ratio from 4:3 to 16:9
-Added fullscreen and mute buttons
-Volume can be adjusted with + and - keypad keys 
-Can go to main menu with "Escape" key now
-Fixed a bug where instead of a music track, windows error beep would play
-Fixed achievement description (score 600 points instead of 500)
-Fixed not being able to take screenshots with F12
